body: I step outside, my eyes scanning the alleyway behind the depot as I notice a trail of leftover food crumbs leading from the back gate. My initial thought is that someone must be feeding the strays, which is both heartwarming and concerning. I recall seeing a few of the stray dogs wandering around the depot area during the day, so this could be the culprit.
